newsitem.title: USA: Greyhound Lines issues $150 mln 10-yr debt.
newsitem.headline: Greyhound Lines issues $150 mln 10-yr debt.

text.p: The following debt issue from Greyhound Lines Inc was priced in the 144A private placement market on Friday, according to a market source.

Proceeds will be used to retire certain long-term indebtedness of Greyhound, including 10 percent senior notes due 2001. They will also be used to fund the company's pending acquisition of Carolina Trailways, and to acquire certain real estate currently leased by the company, Greyhound said.
Greyhound is a nationwide provider of intercity bus transportation. It also provides package express delivery service, charter service, and food service.
Bear Stearns & Co was lead manager.
